findings.mechanism: The client uses an infinite timeout, so a slow or stalled provider blocks the worker indefinitely, leading to full worker saturation.
findings.remediation: set a reasonable timeout (e.g., 5s) and handle timeout errors gracefully
findings.arithmetic: 1 blocked request occupies a worker; with 4 workers all can be blocked => saturation 1 (100%)

findings.mechanism: Catches all exceptions and returns an empty list, silently masking database errors and causing data loss for callers.
